text: When those who disbelieved placed in their hearts the pride—the pride of ignorance; so that they would not acknowledge the message of Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and among that was their refusal to write in the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyyah 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful,' and they refused to write 'This is what Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, has agreed upon,' so Allah sent down tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers with him, and He made them adhere to the word 'There is no god but Allah,' which is the head of all piety, and the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, and the believers with him were more deserving of the word of piety than the polytheists, and they were indeed the people of this word, not the polytheists. And Allah is All-Knowing of everything, nothing is hidden from Him.
